baseFrontend: validated v84 runtime with NexoWatt EOS role, first-login and product branding hardening
label: v87-rc4
notes: Stable fallback 7.9.86 remains available; RC4 is published through npm latest as requested for controlled product acceptance.
Installer and Guest/End User default accounts can perform one passwordless first activation without receiving an unrestricted authenticated session.
Passwordless activation is limited to accounts explicitly marked for first activation and, by default, to private/local networks.
Admin/Service can reopen first activation for installer and end-user accounts; installers can reopen end-user accounts only.
Reset replaces the old password with an unknown random bootstrap secret and forces the user through the one-time password creation page.
The existing administrator account is never included in passwordless activation or role reset.
The NexoWatt EOS product shell and access-management surfaces use the RC4 modern visual layer.
EOS Admin remains on default port 8081; the internal legacy admin remains protected on 127.0.0.1:18081.
changes: Adds private-network, same-origin and rate-limited passwordless first-activation claim endpoints with a short-lived HttpOnly claim cookie.
Adds default Installer and Guest/End User account provisioning and role assignment while replacing blank passwords with unknown random bootstrap secrets.
Adds Admin/Service and Installer account-management endpoints with strict target-role checks.
Adds a modern account-management dialog and login-page first-activation launcher.
Blocks socket commands for non-admin accounts while password setup is required, including already-open sessions after a reset.
Adds modernized cards, dialogs, controls, tables, focus states and responsive product styling without changing the underlying compatibility model.
Allows the explicitly requested npm latest release channel for RC4 and protects it with matching metadata and tests.
